result.title: Splitting Belief Bases Conditionally based on Constraints for c-Representations and their Solutions
result.summary: Splitting notions for conditional belief bases aim at localizing reasoning and computation tasks to subbases containing only the relevant parts of the belief base. Among the different reasoning mechanisms, c-representations, a special kind of Spohn's ranking models, have been shown to provide high-quality inferences. c-Representations can be conveniently specified via a constraint satisfaction problem. In this article, we introduce the notion of conditional constraint splittings, extending constraint splittings by also allowing the subbases to share conditionals. Taking inspiration from conditional syntax splittings, we identify the subclasses of safe and fully localized conditional constraint splittings, allowing us to locally and independently solve the constraint system on the subbases. We also generalize solution splittings for c-representations to safe conditional c-solution splittings and provide an in-depth analysis of their relationship to conditional constraint splittings. Additionally, we elaborate on the relationship of these new splitting notions to safe and generalized safe conditional syntax splittings and also to safe covers, which have been proposed for localized computation of c-representations.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在条件信念库上提出「条件约束分裂」，允许子库共享条件式，并界定安全与完全局部化的子类，使约束系统可在子库上独立局部求解，同时推广 c-representation 的解分裂并分析其与语法分裂、safe covers 的关系。
AI.relevance_reason: 信念库分裂与局部化求解是纯符号工作，与视觉无关，但其「将整体信念状态拆为相关子状态并独立求解」的形式化可能为 latent 推理状态的分解、局部一致性与状态抽象提供概念类比，可供核查。
